title: Start from a chosen value
summary: gsap.from starts with the supplied values and moves to the element's current values.
introduction: gsap.from starts with the supplied values and moves to the element's current values. Your task: Remove the y change to make only a fade.
learningObjectives: Remove the y change to make only a fade.
Explain the example for start from a chosen value

blocks.text: gsap.from starts with the supplied values and moves to the element's current values. It is useful for a simple entrance.
Use a browser project with GSAP 3 installed. Each example creates its own small box. Run one example at a time with a module build tool. GSAP is not loaded by this site's plain runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`from` begins at your supplied values and moves to the element's current values.

blocks.text: The box appears from a slightly lower, transparent starting state.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A from tween reads the current values as its destination. Know the element's normal state first.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Remove the y change to make only a fade.
